subject: Money
title: How Sales Tax Works
description: One-minute skill: How Sales Tax Works.

hook.text: Buy a $100 jacket in New York and pay $108.88. Buy the same jacket in Oregon and pay $100 flat.

buildup.text: Sales tax is collected at purchase. The seller adds the tax, collects it, and sends it to the state.

discovery.text: The U.S. has no federal sales tax. Each state sets its own rate, from 0% to 7.25% in California.

twist.text: Sales tax hits the poor harder. If you spend all your income, all of it gets taxed. That's regressive.

climax.text: Five U.S. states charge zero sales tax. They fund government through other means or lower spending.

punchline.text: The price tag lies. Tax tells the truth.

quiz.question: Why is sales tax considered regressive?
options: It takes a larger share from lower incomes
It only applies to luxury goods
